Graduation with Civic Honors: Unlock the Power of Community Opportunity

Civic Honors was published in 2006. It explores how high schools and colleges can foster civic engagement in local communities.

The story behind graduation with civic honors began in an academic setting during the spring semester of 2002 at the University of Kansas.

Dr. Nels Lindahl studied at the University of Kansas and took a class from Dr. H. George Frederickson entitled Concepts of Civil Society.

Dr. Raymond Davis offered guidance and Dr. Thomas Longoria highlighted the importance of community collaboration.
